scope: PCRR, CSRC, ASR, PGM on identical MVTec common geometry

shared.d_rank_population: strict D_rank below within-image median and all three stage anomaly percentiles < 0.5
shared.matching: frozen deployed score + D_rank deterministic same-class quantile-bin matching
shared.shift: per-image np.roll by (172,172) pixels after evidence construction

family_isolation.pcrr: PCRR configs only plus B1 and current development-class metrics
family_isolation.csrc: CSRC configs only plus B1 and current development-class metrics
family_isolation.asr: ASR configs only plus B1 and current development-class metrics
family_isolation.pgm: PGM configs only plus B1 and current development-class metrics
